affectedPublicSurfaces: GitHub issue->wave and wave->main merge eligibility via pr.yml (three-tier CI behavior)
Deterministic main-tier artifact-gate job (renamed from ai-review) that validates manifest-listed issues on wave->main

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: RED->GREEN CI contract tests + actionlint on feature/issue-660-ci-wave-2 (no deployed candidate; pr.yml governs merge eligibility only)

journeys.name: issue-tier-minimal-and-base-skip
assertions: issue->wave required jobs are classify-tier/changes/gitleaks/policy-checks plus path-filtered lint/typecheck/PR-safe test/frontend/demo-frontend
validate/generate artifact jobs are not issue-tier blockers
base-only synchronization with unchanged PR head SHA skips issue-tier heavy work
any head SHA change runs the issue tier

journeys.name: manifest-membership-and-deferred-artifact-gate
assertions: policy-checks requires feature/issue-N* linkage and N present in the target wave manifest using the CI-WAVE-1 validator
ai-review is renamed to artifact-gate and runs on the main tier only
on wave->main artifact-gate validates every manifest-listed issue's artifacts (existence + status PASS)
tier-aware status aggregation cannot pass when classifier/manifest/artifact checks fail

journeys.name: no-double-run-cleanliness-audit
assertions: lint/typecheck/frontend/demo-frontend do not re-execute the same compile/lint/build on the main tier after running at issue tier
an issue-tier lint/type regression still fails at issue tier

migrationCompatibility.notes: CI-only change to pr.yml and contract tests. No database or public API schema changes; wave manifest schema (CI-WAVE-1) is consumed, not modified.

rollbackAssertion.preCutoverFailureBehavior: Do not merge the CI-WAVE-2 pr.yml slice; issue tier stays blocked until contract tests and actionlint pass.
rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: Revert the pr.yml workflow commit; the pre-existing #657 three-tier behavior returns and the CI-WAVE-1 validator (#659) remains active.

doNotInfer: issue-tier CI success or a green pr.yml run deploys production
removing artifact validation from issue pushes removes the main-tier artifact-gate enforcement
renaming ai-review to artifact-gate adds any LLM/model step to CI
free-merge into wave waives the wave manifest membership requirement
this slice runs a deployed candidate target or live TikTok sandbox calls
